verdict.rationale: Aircall's pricing page documents business-hours scheduling combined with IVR routing, so the core capability exists as a product feature. Nothing in the pack shows how open versus closed behavior is configured, whether schedules apply per number, or whether holidays are handled. Missing for 10: documented open/closed routing behavior, holiday schedules or exceptions, per-number configuration, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
